title: What the Fingers Let Fall

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A handful lifted and let fall back tells you the grain is dry. It tells you nothing of the hands that sowed it, and nothing of what the season will ask for it.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the drying racks, told in the last tend of Bone

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and twenty-one to three hundred and twenty-three days, six months and one hundred and forty-one to one hundred and forty-three days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory; the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone, never a break in the narration. That register takes the body in its old order each morning — the crust two inches from the ear, gone leathery in the dry kiln heat with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and reads the world the way a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse, and that the infant's want of the crust is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins; the argument is the work. Three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, not numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night; the told figure beside the paid. Five arithmetics of the year stand behind one printed figure after Bone's second reading: one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, five readings five and not one account, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer. The staying at the inch and the early letting-go of Bone 17 are two objects on two places with a finger between them, neither made again; two hundred and sixteen honest answers stand on the sixth place at the opening and two hundred and twenty-two at the close. The chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and not paid, is domestic and held: on Bone 22 Sella lifts the wool from the dressed grain, takes a small handful and lets it fall back through her fingers onto the heap instead of spreading it, testing dryness with no figure and no word; the boy reads it as a dressing's edge lifted and allowed to fall and files it on a place of its own, not a fifth held change, not a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, and not made again on Bone 23 or 24.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Twenty-Second Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{321}{Bone 22, Secondday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Secondday with no market, Cross or bell. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer two hundred and sixteen as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; do not recap Chapter 89. Carry three hundred and twenty to three hundred and twenty-one exact, six months and one hundred and forty-one days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and twenty-one days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Nothing from Bone 20's reading comes in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment and the reading is not re-read. Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: the stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. He knows the composed face is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly; he wants the crust lifted two inches and the thread wiped and cannot close two inches on the pot handle set beyond his reach. Both true, the second louder, the argument the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifts the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crosses the crack and says both proverbs to the pot and the fire with the crack left showing, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T009/T013/T092, T077). The widow's mark is touched at no hour because a morning and a hearth are not openings; five openings in five months are five and not a rule. Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell in its square beside the told; the told figure beside the paid. The file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap. The hand outside the wool goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole, lets it go on the same low note and comes straight down on answer two hundred and seventeen — exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer.

scenes.title: The Handful at the Rack End
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 321, no new dated heading: afternoon through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the rack end, the yard well and its flat stone, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the bed, boards and towel. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate, gives the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey hairline beside it called the thaw, unswept both; the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lie; the round ring where the shallow clay pan once stood with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the water in the trough; the field's empty place out on the worked strips; and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out — no eighth likeness stood up as a row and no figure spoken over the going (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T060/T086). Three coverings at the well stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause: the stayed frost gone off the north lip on Bone 3 while the yard looked elsewhere, the skin on the trough, the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone out of the path of feet (T083/T085 held). Bone's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: a man come down from Cold Acre with a hare across his shoulders answers the price with the weather and goes toward the clay road with nobody weighing the hare and nobody opening a slate; another with a cracked jar in a rope sling is told to ask the pot, and the pot, being a pot, says nothing (T077). **The chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T077, T060/T086, T061/T082):** at the rack end Sella lifts the wool from the dressed grain, takes a small handful and lets it fall back through her fingers onto the heap instead of spreading it, the way a hand tests whether a thing is dry; she gives no figure and no word and does not repeat it. The boy reads it as a surgeon lifts a dressing's edge and lets it fall, files it on a place of its own with a finger between it and the four held changes and between it and his own gaps, and forbids it to stand up as a fifth held change, a sign, a lesson, a mending, a cause, a fifth arithmetic or a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stands. At the kindling Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there as a ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holding light, no collector coming (T036/T076/T006). At the shed's edge Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, gives no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the full note he knows three turns ahead, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, and keeps he's not Vail sealed (T035/T031/T062). Garl stays in objects and not in a story, name unspoken three hundred and twenty-one days, tile debt uncalled. At the close the hand takes a small intake and lets it go whole on the river's note on answer two hundred and eighteen; the note had done before the hand came down, so the letting-go was neither early again nor stayed.

scenes.title: The Twenty-Third Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{322}{Bone 23, Thirdday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Thirdday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 22 comes in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, and the handful at the rack end is held as one object and is not made again. Carry three hundred and twenty-one to three hundred and twenty-two exact, six months and one hundred and forty-two days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and twenty-two days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order; the surgeon's knowing that a cold patient cannot clot buys nothing at two inches of air while the infant's want of the crust and the wiped thread is louder, both true, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, lifts the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crosses the crack, stands a moment counting small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, turns the dressed grain beneath the wool with the lighter touch and no figure — and this morning does not lift a handful or let one fall — sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and touches the widow's mark at no hour because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079/T100, T077, T009/T013/T092). Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the two small objects of the hand, the staying of Bone 15 and the early letting-go of Bone 17, each on its own place with a finger between and neither repeated; two hundred and seventeen honest answers on the sixth. The five arithmetics ride locked up the clay road in Berr's box, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, five readings five and not one account, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful or the boy's gaps (T015/T041/T047). The file lies open on the towel with every gap gap. The hand comes up an inch, takes a small intake, holds it whole, lets it go on the same low note and comes straight down on answer two hundred and nineteen.

scenes.title: The Ninth Hand at the Well
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Bone 23 through the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and its flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the bed, boards and towel. Sella carries him at the half-pace and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause; the dressed grain lies turned under wool and given no figure (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085 held, T077). At the yard well Ilva draws with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the dry cold and giving its small dry rasp as the bucket comes up, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey dust of the drying racks worked into the seam of one thumb she does not scrub out; her hands know the weight of a pail and the edge of a wet board and have never been soft. A woman asks what the firings of Bone have taken. Ilva's hand goes toward her sleeve and stays; the short strip of notched birch bark, pale where a thumb has rubbed the notches and dark in the uncut grain between, is not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, the cord, the open slate a pace away, the knot-string or the ownerless saying, and no figure comes off the wood. Her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both with a half-beat between, and she answers the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. She puts the flat of her hand once more on the sleeve and goes back to the pail, and nobody turns twice (T080 advanced, not paid). The boy takes the order of reaching apart as a chart is taken apart and files it as no tenth hand: Ilva's ninth stays nine on its own place with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth, nine objects and not a rule, and she is not made a reader of her own keeping, not Marra, not the soft-handed man, not the soft-cuffed clerk at the landing, not Hessa, not the green-mouthed woman at the pot board, and is joined to none of them. The holding tray is checked unchanged: burned slate five with a finger between the fifth and the four and no sixth, no witness, no hand at the flame and no payer, the claim going on gathering interest against Jorra's ungiven promise; the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness; the well-saying at three shapings; the shut-room tellings at two; the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart; six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the two shut-room tellings; the returned half-check of Bone 8 on the flagstone's own place with the Day 161 damper fraction, the Day 166 shelf beat and the Frost 5 returned beat — four held changes on four places and not a rule, and the handful at the rack end not made a fifth (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076, T061/T082, T101, T035/T031/T065/T095). The heard bell stays in its square beside the told; the seven green stays a colour and the seven shape a shape with no eighth. At the close the hand takes a small intake and lets it go whole on the river's note on answer two hundred and twenty; it has not stayed and it has not let go early.

scenes.title: The Twenty-Fourth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{323}{Bone 24, Fourthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Fourthday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 22 or 23 comes in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the handful is not made again, and Bone 30 (Day 329) is six mornings ahead and is not brought early. Carry three hundred and twenty-two to three hundred and twenty-three exact, six months and one hundred and forty-three days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and twenty-three days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: crust, unnamed gap, thread, cold, the waiting afterdrop; the composed face that is not composure; the infant's want louder than the surgeon's knowing, both true, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, lifts the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crosses the crack and both proverbs to pot and fire with the crack showing, keeps the charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, the two gaps unfigured, one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing, turns the dressed grain beneath the wool with the lighter touch and no figure and does not lift a handful, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and touches the widow's mark at no hour because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079/T100, T077, T009/T013/T092). Under the floor the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood; overhead four nails, four and a knot; through the finger's-width door water over water — three counts in three places that do not become one. Six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh empty. The file lies open on the towel with every gap gap, the staying and the early letting-go two objects on two places and neither repeated, two hundred and twenty honest answers on the sixth. The hand comes up an inch, takes a small intake, holds the interval whole, lets it go on the same low note and comes straight down on answer two hundred and twenty-one.

scenes.title: The Count Goes On
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 323, Bone 24, the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the bed, boards and towel. Bone goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is corrected; the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the month's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the arm and the weather, never figures, and the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085, T077). The chapter's held movement is checked and left on a place of its own: the handful let fall back through Sella's fingers at the rack end on Bone 22 is one object, not made again on Bone 23 or 24, not a fifth held change, sign, lesson, mending, cause, sixth arithmetic or rule, with a finger between it and the four held changes on four places and between it and the boy's own gaps — a testing that took nothing and paid nothing, kept because it was true and not because it bought anything (T077, T060/T086, T061/T082). The staying stays one object and the early letting-go stays one object, neither made again. Five arithmetics with their true subtractions ride locked up the clay road in Berr's box toward High Kiln, one in twelve unchallenged, figure read still not figure paid, no signature, five readings five and not one account, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the two small objects of the hand or the boy's gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). The whole holding tray is checked unchanged: burned slate at five with no sixth, row at five askings with no witness, well-saying at three shapings, nine hands with Ilva's strip in a sleeve and no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, two shut-room tellings, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, five openings in five months with the next far off, seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth, the heard bell in its square beside the told, no collector up or down the clay road. Garl stays in objects, his name unspoken three hundred and twenty-three days and the tile debt uncalled. At the very end of the day, when the yard has gone quiet and the river's note has come down to its lowest under the finger's-width door, the hand outside the wool goes up an inch, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole, lets it go on the same low note and comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. The note had done before the hand came down, so the letting-go was neither early again nor stayed. He files it as answer two hundred and twenty-two: exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the five arithmetics, the bell's gap, the covered grain, the handful, the stayed object, the early letting-go nor his own gaps. Two hundred and twenty-two honest answers stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, and neither the number nor the small hand-movings stood up and called themselves a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. Three hundred and twenty-three stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath; six months and one hundred and forty-three days are told by nobody; the fire's fifth is unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed; Garl's name has not been spoken under the roof the same number. Nothing on the twenty-fourth was opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended; the keeping of the number was the only honest work there was to do and bought nothing at two inches of air, and Bone went on without a boundary drawn.
